brief: wave-1 piece W1-17 — Dialogue and disposition
findings: RI-DLG01 §D targets: >=400 topic nodes, 7-10 roots, >=55 topics answerable in a mid-size settlement, >=30 topics w/ settlement-local answer, mean out-degree >=2.0, leaf frac <=50%, >=90% reachable only via another topic, max depth >=6, median depth >=3, ZERO orphans, ZERO unreachable INFOs, convergence >=20%, quest-topic frac <=15%, menu_quest_fraction <=0.30.
RI-DLG01 Greeting 0-9 priority classes; first-match-wins in authored order; filter fields: actor,race,class,faction,npcRank,cell(prefix),pcFaction,pcRank,sex,dispMin,+6 function/variable conds.

RI-DLG03 §C tier counts: Tier A 30 greetings/5 bands/>=4 per band/28 rumours/20 unique/12 act-gated; Tier B 24/5/3/20/14/8. names-the-town >=70%. cross-town rumour Jaccard <0.15. act Jaccard <=0.70. diegetic lint regex bans quest/objective/marker/coords.

RI-DLG04 all 22 GMSTs + derivedDisposition + persuasionRatings + attempt + barter formulas. d = 1-0.02*|D-50|. fDispCrimeMod=0.02 (our deviation). Bands 0-19/20-39/40-59/60-79/80-100. sigma(baseDisposition)>=12, no single value >25%.

RI-DLG06 §B: 6 archetypes with w/sent bands 16-19,10-13,7-9,12-15,7-9,16-19; global spread >=8.0; pairwise separation on w/sent 2.0 OR <=6w 15pp OR STTR 0.06; >=5 marker words at lift>=5x; address form >=1.0/1k that is <=0.3/1k in >=4 others; a regexable grammar tic.

RI-DLG09 parley: interact held, arm 1-12 (free cancel), startup 13-42 (commit, guard drops f13), offer 43-54 (parley event on f43), recovery 55-102. 102 f@60 total, 90 committed. stamina 20 on f13, regen delay 42 f@60. Routes K>F>R>G>D. Refusal: Fight+10, perm -5, cooldown 600 f@60, 2nd refusal parley_locked. YIELD persistent world flag, baseDisposition -10, souls 0, COMBAT ends.

Corpus data: corpus/40-dialogue/data/morrowind-dialogue.csv.gz cols Source,InfoId,Race,Gender,SpeakerId,FactionId,FactionRank,DialogueText. 69876 rows. Canonical scope = Source in {Morrowind,Tribunal,Bloodmoon} dedup exact text = 27875 texts / 682372 words / 24.5 w per entry.
MEASURED: oracle vs engine, 100,000 randomised cases, 0 mismatches on derivedDisposition (exact int) and target1/2/3 (1e-3). RI-DLG04 step 1 PASS.

MEASURED: my sentence-metric method reproduces RI-DLG06 §A's named-speaker table from corpus/40-dialogue/data/morrowind-dialogue.csv.gz: Divayth Fyr w/sent 6.54 vs item 6.5 and <=6w 59.4% vs 59.4%; Caius 8.89 vs 9.0, 42.5% vs 41.9%; Aryon 10.40 vs 10.4; Nileno 8.77 vs 9.4. Method: dedupe on exact DialogueText, %VAR -> X, sentence split on (?<=[.!?])\s+, words [A-Za-z']+. The class-filter table (§A first table) CANNOT be reproduced from this CSV: it has no class column (cols are Done,Conflict,Source,InfoId,Race,Gender,SpeakerId,FactionId,FactionRank,DialogueText).
MEASURED: Argonian register, 2,722 distinct lines: w/entry 28.28, w/sent 9.72, <=6w 42.0%, >20w 8.5%.
